name: Pain research: 6-minimax-m3
description: Independent research run '6-minimax-m3' (command-code-research, minimaxai/minimax-m3). OUTPUT_DIR=<mission>/research/runs/6-minimax-m3. Follow prd-pain-research.md exactly; write only in OUTPUT_DIR; never read other folders under research/runs/.

userStories.title: Plan the search
userStories.description: OUTPUT_DIR=<mission>/research/runs/6-minimax-m3. Read the 'Read first' files and the Search toolkit. Write plan.md with at least 15 concrete queries across at least 6 source types (include GitHub-reactions, Reddit-top and HN-points API queries) and 5 hypotheses. Follow the Guardrails, Search toolkit and formats in the source PRD (prd-pain-research.md).
acceptanceCriteria: OUTPUT_DIR/plan.md exists with at least 15 queries, at least 6 source types and at least 6 hypotheses, one of them on vision and video
No file was written outside OUTPUT_DIR
userStories.notes: WATCHDOG: never enter or use plan mode; this is a write task. Write files in OUTPUT_DIR directly with your file tools.

userStories.title: Collect evidence into nodes
userStories.description: OUTPUT_DIR=<mission>/research/runs/6-minimax-m3. Run the searches with every tool: web search, web fetch, and curl against the GitHub search API (sort=reactions), Reddit search.json (sort=top) and HN Algolia. Cover at least 8 of the popular places listed in the PRD. Write node files and sources.md. Follow the Guardrails, Search toolkit and formats in the source PRD (prd-pain-research.md).
acceptanceCriteria: OUTPUT_DIR/nodes/ has at least 12 P##-*.md files in the node format, each with at least 2 evidence links
At least 3 nodes are pains not listed in section 5 of 00-context-notes.md
The vision and video area is searched (PR visual checks, images for agents, bug video for agents): at least 2 nodes, or a section in sources.md explaining why the evidence was not found
sources.md lists every cited URL; at least 8 of the PRD's popular places are covered and named in sources.md
Popularity signals (reactions, score, points, comments) are recorded where the source shows them

userStories.notes: WATCHDOG: never enter or use plan mode; this is a write task. Write files in OUTPUT_DIR directly with your file tools.

userStories.title: Verify and clean
userStories.description: OUTPUT_DIR=<mission>/research/runs/6-minimax-m3. Open every cited URL with web fetch or curl. Mark verified, unverified or dropped; merge duplicates; drop claims without a verified source. Follow the Guardrails, Search toolkit and formats in the source PRD (prd-pain-research.md).
acceptanceCriteria: sources.md starts with a line 'verified: N, unverified: N, dropped: N' with real counts
Every node has a status field and no node relies only on unverified or dropped sources for its main claim

userStories.title: Score and rank
userStories.description: OUTPUT_DIR=<mission>/research/runs/6-minimax-m3. Score every node with the rubric and write ranking.md (two tables) and ranking.json (exact schema). Follow the Guardrails, Search toolkit and formats in the source PRD (prd-pain-research.md).
acceptanceCriteria: ranking.md has a pain_score table and a pick_score table, plus reasons for the top five
`python3 -c "import json;json.load(open('ranking.json'))"` succeeds in OUTPUT_DIR and the JSON matches the schema (pain_score=2f+2s, pick_score=2f+2s+2fit+small+novelty)
